entities.name: Teresa Janina Kierocinska
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Teresa Janina Kierocińska was a Discalced Carmelite nun born in Wieluń, who cofounded the Carmelite Sisters of the Infant Jesus and was honored with the title of the Righteous Among the Nations.
